description: A null filling a missing optional object attribute converts through a map of any back to the object
notes: The test uses convert-with-defaults, which gives the missing attribute x a null, because hashicorp/hcl's convert fails for a value that lacks an optional attribute (native/type-expressions/convert-missing-optional-attribute). go-cty makes that null with the attribute's type constraint, which still has the optional attribute b (conversionMapToObject in cty/convert/conversion_collection.go), and the map of any keeps that type as its element type, for y too. Converting the map to the object type gives each null the type without b's optional marker.
